meta.name: Special OPS
meta.description: The series follows Himmat Singh of Research and Analysis Wing who draws similar patterns in terrorist attacks and is convinced a single person is behind all the attacks. His task force team of five agents living in various parts of the world aim to catch the mastermind. The story is based on an inspiration taken from nineteen years worth of national significant events.

videos.title: Kaagaz Ke Phool
videos.overview: When a set of R&AW officials are asked to create an audit report of Himmat Singh’s "miscellaneous" expenses, a nineteen-year-old theory finally sees a glimmer of light.

videos.title: Guide
videos.overview: The 26/11 terror attack moves the nation and one link leads to the next, guiding Himmat and team closer to their target.

videos.title: Mughal-E-Azam
videos.overview: Shipping business tycoon, Hafiz Ali shows the aftermath of a betrayal. The nineteen-year-old saga begins to set the stage for a mammoth reveal.

videos.title: Hum Kisi Se Kam Nahin
videos.overview: Four assets and four tasks. Himmat’s team is challenged to test their mettle and see if they are ready for the storm coming their way.

videos.title: Chaudvin Ka Chand
videos.overview: Farooq’s long wait comes to an end and he's face-to-face with Hafiz. Baku is added to the Special Ops map and new players are revealed.

videos.title: Qurbani
videos.overview: Farooq's just a few feet away from the mastermind behind 2001 Parliament attack and yet again it’s a touch and go situation for Himmat. Time for a setback. Time for a sacrifice.

videos.title: Shatranj Ke Khiladi
videos.overview: Hafiz smells a mole and Himmat finds a pawn. Mind games help Farooq to survive another day.

videos.title: Sholay
videos.overview: Showdown! The country is under an imminent attack and time is running out. Finally, Himmat comes face to face with his nemesis.

videos.title: Friday
videos.overview: AI scientist Dr Bhargav's abduction from a tech summit and a senior R&AW officer's killing in Delhi push Himmat Singh to realise the beginning of a silent war.

videos.title: Saturday
videos.overview: Probing Chaddha and Banerjee, Himmat learns about Shekhawat's mission. Subramanyam pressures Himmat to grab a bank defaulter. Farooq goes to Athens to locate another AI scientist.

videos.title: Sunday
videos.overview: Avinash finds a critical lead in Budapest. Himmat learns that the attacks are part of a covert cyber war by China and a larger digital offensive designed to destabilise India.

videos.title: Monday
videos.overview: Avinash and Juhi head to Dominica to trace Jignesh Dholakia, who Subramanyam wants arrested at any cost. Meanwhile, Himmat's daughter, Pari, finds long-buried secrets.

videos.title: Tuesday
videos.overview: As the web tightens, Himmat suspects a mole within, which leads him to the Collector. Meanwhile, Abbas is tasked with digging into Subramanyam.

videos.title: Wednesday
videos.overview: Himmat pieces together the identity of Sudheer Awasthi, who is pulling the strings of the imminent cyber warfare. Later, he finds the mole leaking internal information.

videos.title: Thursday
videos.overview: With the clock ticking and the nation hanging by a thread, Himmat and his core squad brace themselves before Sudheer's final phase goes live with the help of Dr Bhargav.
